entity.description: One user-written JEXL script: its read spec, its body, the profile it runs under and a sample input to try it on.

field.name: scriptProfile
field.description: A profile name from org.moqui.jexl.ScriptProfiles (EXPRESSION, SCRIPT, or one the application adds).

field.name: readSpecJson
field.description: The read step (JSON): the inputs read before the script runs, each from the entity source or a ScriptSource. Empty: the script's input is its sample, or what the caller passes.

field.name: scriptBody
field.description: The JEXL source; it reads only input.

field.name: sampleInputJson
field.description: JSON the script is tried on before it is saved, and its input when there is no read spec and no input service.

entity.description: A user script put to work: on its cron (read in timeZone), as its owner, the read step (or the input service) reads the input, the script runs, and each active delivery receives the result. The script never does I/O itself. Run by org.moqui.jexl.ScriptDeploymentScheduler (moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.run#DueUserScriptDeployments).

field.name: timeZone
field.description: Zone id the cron is read in; the server's zone when empty.

field.name: ownerUserId
field.description: The user the run reads as, re-checked at every run (enabled, and allowed to schedule). Whoever turns the deployment on, or changes its deliveries or its script, becomes the owner.

field.name: inputServiceName
field.description: A service implementing moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.read#UserScriptDeploymentInput, for hosts that compute the input in code; the script's read spec is the default path.

field.name: nextRunDate
field.description: When it is next due; set on save and moved forward as each run is claimed.

field.name: lastRunUnits
field.description: Work units the last run's script used.

field.name: parametersJson
field.description: The delivery's own parameters (addresses, a topic, ...).

field.name: lastOutcome
field.description: OK, TOO_LARGE or FAILED, from the newest run.

entity.description: One run of a user script, ad hoc or by a deployment: when, as whom, how it ended, what it read and where it went. Kept for jexl_run_retention_days (default 30).

field.name: scriptDeploymentId
field.description: Empty for an ad hoc run.

field.name: statusId
field.description: OK, NOTHING_TO_SEND, HELD, DISABLED, OWNER_LOST, READ_ERROR, READ_NOT_ALLOWED, READ_TOO_LARGE, SCRIPT_ERROR, RESULT_INVALID, DELIVERY_PARTIAL, DELIVERY_FAILED or STUCK.

field.name: errorKind
field.description: For SCRIPT_ERROR: UNITS, TIME, MEMORY, NOT_ALLOWED, ERROR, ...

field.name: readCountsJson
field.description: Rows each input handed the script.

entity.description: A read source an application adds for the read step: its name (used as an input's source) and a service implementing moqui.jexl.ScriptServices.read#ScriptSource. The built-in source "entity" needs no row.
